categories.main_business_segments: Hi-Trend Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, and sales of chips for smart grid terminal devices and battery management systems (BMS). Its core product lines include energy metering chips, smart meter MCU chips, power line carrier communication chips, and BMS chips, serving applications in smart meters, data collectors, concentrators, electric vehicles, consumer electronics, and industrial energy storage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced integrated circuit design technologies including high-precision Sigma-Delta ADCs, high-precision voltage references, embedded PLLs, and low-power MCU designs. It utilizes a fabless model outsourcing wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries. Key technologies include power line carrier communication algorithms (BPSK, OFDM, G3-PLC, HPLC), dual-mode communication combining PLC and RF, and high-precision battery management algorithms. The company also focuses on RISC-V architecture MCU development and has obtained ISO26262 ASIL D certification for automotive-grade chip safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company’s primary customers are smart grid terminal equipment manufacturers, including major electric grid operators such as State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, as well as domestic and overseas smart meter manufacturers. It also serves emerging markets in battery management for electric vehicles, industrial energy storage, and consumer electronics. Overseas markets include Southeast Asia, Eastern Europe, and Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are primarily concentrated in China, including key regions served by State Grid and Southern Power Grid. The company has expanded its footprint internationally with growing sales in Southeast Asia, Eastern Europe, and Africa. Its registered office and main R&D centers are located in Shanghai, with subsidiaries in Shanghai and Nanjing.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hi-Trend operates as a fabless semiconductor design company focusing on upstream chip design and development. It outsources wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to foundries and subcontractors, while managing design, R&D, and sales. The company maintains strategic partnerships with wafer foundries and packaging/testing firms to ensure supply chain stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment to maintain technological leadership in smart grid chips and expand into BMS and industrial automation. Key R&D directions include next-generation smart meter SoC chips, dual-mode power line carrier and RF communication chips, high-precision and low-power BMS chips, and RISC-V based MCUs. It aims to accelerate product industrialization, enhance core technology capabilities, and expand applications in energy IoT, new energy, and digital economy sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of integrated circuit chips and related technical services. The company sells products mainly via a buyout distribution model to downstream smart meter manufacturers and directly to select customers. It also earns investment income from financial assets and equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hi-Trend is a leading domestic supplier in the smart meter chip market, holding a top market share in three-phase metering chips and MCU chips for State Grid and export markets. It competes with international semiconductor firms in power line communication and BMS chip segments but leverages its comprehensive product lines, strong R&D, and local market presence to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 591.87 million, a slight decrease of 1.85% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 93.59 million, down 28.79%. R&D investment increased by 18.02% to RMB 181.34 million, accounting for 30.64% of revenue. Total assets were RMB 2.02 billion with net assets of RMB 1.87 billion. The company has shown stable growth with strong cash flow generation and maintains a solid financial position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hi-Trend emphasizes high precision, high reliability, and low power consumption in its chip products, tailored for complex smart grid environments. Its comprehensive product portfolio covers metering, MCU, communication, and BMS chips, enabling integrated solutions for smart meters and energy management. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, proprietary algorithms, and certifications (e.g., ISO26262 for automotive safety) differentiate it by offering advanced, secure, and cost-effective chip solutions that meet domestic and international standards.
